047/assembler.title: Instruction groups: data movement, I/O, arithmetic, control and compare
047/assembler.subtitle: Classify each instruction by its purpose before tracing its effect.
cards: DATA MOVEMENT
Move values among immediate data, memory, ACC and IX.

LDM #n       ACC <- n
LDD address  ACC <- MEM[address]
LDI address  ACC <- MEM[MEM[address]]
LDX address  ACC <- MEM[address + IX]
LDR #n       IX <- n
MOV IX       IX <- ACC
STO address  MEM[address] <- ACC
LDR is immediate to IX, not relative.
INPUT/OUTPUT + ARITHMETIC
Input and output use ASCII codes in ACC. Arithmetic changes ACC or a named register.

IN            key ASCII -> ACC
OUT           ACC ASCII -> screen
ADD value     ACC <- ACC + value
SUB value     ACC <- ACC - value
INC register  register <- register + 1
DEC register  register <- register - 1
Immediate values may use #, B or &.
CONTROL + COMPARE
JMP is unconditional. CMP and CMI set a True/False comparison result used by JPE or JPN.

JMP address   always jump
CMP value     compare ACC directly
CMI address   compare ACC indirectly
JPE address   jump if comparison True
JPN address   jump if comparison False
END           return control to OS
JPE is not 'equal'; JPN is not 'negative'.
047/assembler.footer: Five groups: data movement • input/output • arithmetic • unconditional/conditional instructions • compare.

051/shifts.title: Binary shifts: logical, arithmetic, cyclic
051/shifts.subtitle: Every input and stored result below is exactly 8 bits wide.
cards: LOGICAL LEFT / RIGHT
Empty positions receive 0; the outgoing end bit is discarded.

LSL 1
10110011 -> 01100110
out left 1; zero enters right

LSR 1
10110011 -> 01011001
out right 1; zero enters left
Unsigned LSL overflow: Yes (179 x 2 > 255).
ARITHMETIC LEFT / RIGHT
Left shift inserts 0. Right shift copies the original sign bit.

ASL 1
10110011 -> 01100110
sign 1 becomes 0

ASR 1
10110011 -> 11011001
sign bit 1 copied left
Signed ASL overflow: Yes (sign changed).
CYCLIC LEFT / RIGHT
The outgoing bit rotates into the empty position at the opposite end.

ROL 1
10110011 -> 01100111
left 1 rotates to right

ROR 1
10110011 -> 11011001
right 1 rotates to left
No bit is discarded; an overflow label is not used.
051/shifts.footer: Fixed width keeps 8 stored bits; overflow depends on the signed or unsigned numeric interpretation.
